kindNotes: hud.action-dock: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
hud.event-chips: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
modal.history.records: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
modal.history.snapshot-figure: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
modal.history.family-tree: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
modal.history.thread-decision: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
modal.history.thread-because: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)

hud.status-pill.data: seed 1 stone town: date, population, food, coin

hud.season-strip-panel.data: the town's year strip with its marks and the food line

hud.time-cluster.data: the speed seals (PLAY-2: the fast seal's mark ×5·10) and the settings button

hud.settings-popover.data: autoplay, tutorial, audio, save and render switches

hud.action-dock.data: build, ledger, steward (undo when a site is new)

hud.steward-bubble.data: the steward's line (quiet, or the advisor's line when he speaks)

hud.event-card.lord-moment.data: the lord's suit filed: its Wave 40 picture and the ledger's sentence

hud.event-card.family-moment.data: the first child: the ledger's sentence, the child and the parents named, the way to the chronicle

modal.history.family-links.data: the first child's record in the chronicle (as modal.history.records: the detail scrolls): a biography button for each person its record names

hud.pause-veil.data: the paused town's badge (speed 0, no modal)

hud.era-ceremony.unreachable: shows only on the tick an era is entered; no cached state sits on that tick (survey §2: static contrast check only)

hud.zone-toolbar.data: the zone layer's kinds and tools

hud.prediction-chip.data: a living tool's placement chip over open ground

hud.build-details.unreachable: the HUD's build drawer is controlled, which hides the details' toggle (BuildMenu.tsx: `open !== undefined`); nothing opens it in play

slot.goals.data: the goal log, the settlement line and its progress

slot.goals.drawer.data: the goal log inside the slot

slot.population.panel.data: the population log inside the slot

slot.ledger.steward.data: the stone town's stocks with the steward's advice open

hud.steward-bubble.ledger.data: the steward's open advice beside the ledger

map.selection.farmstead.data: a farmstead and its crop choice

modal.pause.data: the pause menu and its settings

modal.year-review.data: 1302's card at 1303's first tick: its decisions (or none), the factions' moves, the town's people and money

modal.famine.data: chapter 1's famine decision (DEC-CARD: four answers, the steward beside the stake)

hud.event-card.famine-answered.data: chapter 1's famine after the answer: the line, until when, the bottleneck left

modal.petition.heir.data: the heir's card with three candidates

modal.person-card.data: a house member's card (one wearing a state ornament when the house has one)

modal.history.records.data: the stone town's chronicle: timeline, filters, record list, detail

modal.history.snapshot-figure.data: the then-map with its caption (the caption measured beside the framed box)

modal.history.biography.king.data: the king's biography: the empty-records line

modal.lord.home-petition.data: the boundary dispute (Wave 44 01) in the DEC-CARD layout: the situation, the stake, each answer now / later / who remembers

modal.lord.home-petition.guardian.data: a minor lord's wardship petition (the court line with his guardian)

modal.lord.request.data: the town's request (a proclamation waiting) in the DEC-CARD layout: the grant's now (the works it opens) and later (the actual's day)

modal.lord.registry.data: the first v4 offer the registry drew in the lord's slice (DEC-CARD layout): its why, each answer's tradeoff, now / later / who remembers, the shut one with why

modal.lord.registry-hold.data: the first v4 offer with a hold the lord can choose (DEC-CARD layout): the hold's cost as the engine's run shows it (the claim weakened)

hud.food-breakdown.data: the town's food split five ways, the ledger and close buttons

hud.event-card.will-kept.data: the father's new will as its chip's card: the engine's deadline as a season, the button to the lord screen's marriage page

modal.lord.will-change.data: the father's new will: favour (shut when the treasury is short), support promised (its promise, stake and witnesses), let it stand (the rival's claim) — the engine's run

hud.event-card.suit-defence.data: a neighbour house's suit against the lord: its filing, its stage and next season, the button to the suit in the ledger

hud.event-card.entry-threat.data: a house's forcible entry forewarned: the engine's warning, the season it comes, the button to the warning in the ledger

hud.event-card.audit-kept.data: an audit's finding as its chip's card: what it found, the engine's deadline as a season, the button to the card

hud.event-card.offmap-kept.data: an off-map estate's petition as its chip's card: the ask, the engine's deadline as a season, why it came to the lord, the button to the card

modal.lord.contested.data: the contested inheritance: the rival's hold, both claims' strength, the lord's suit stage, the way to the suit

hud.event-card.trace.data: the season's news of the lord's decision (the suit filed on the first tick): its year and subject, the neighbour's mind, the way to the chronicle

modal.history.thread-decision.data: the suit filed in 1300, opened from its later chip: what followed (its turns) and who remembers it

modal.history.thread-because.data: a suit's turn: the decision it followed from (the year and who decided), its link back

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-041.data: the pannage petition on the woodland in autumn in 041's words (the longest variant body)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-048.data: the common-pasture petition in 048's words (the commons against the second merchant house)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-056.data: the road and bridge petition beside the market in 056's words

modal.lord.registry.variant-067.data: 031's steward offer in 067's words (ability against loyalty; the longest variant title)

modal.lord.registry.variant-078.data: 019's oversight offer in 078's words (the merchant's man against the peasants')

hud.event-card.home-petition-variant.data: the pannage petition's chip card in 041's words, its card put off

hud.event-card.registry-variant.data: 031's offer's chip card in 067's words, its card put off
